Name: Phurah, Servant of Gideon
Summary: Phurah was Gideon's servant, who went with him by night to the edge of the Midianite camp, where they overheard the dream that strengthened Gideon.
KeyStory: When Gideon feared to go down to the host, God told him to take Phurah his servant; together they heard a Midianite tell his dream of a barley cake overturning a tent, and Gideon worshipped.
LifeLesson: Courage sometimes needs one companion in the dark.
